text:
sarah_sales: FYI — FinLedger wants BYO-KMS (HSM-backed) for the POC. They plan to put our keybroker connector behind their outbound proxy. Main asks: network egress requirements, pen-test window, and an updated quote for BYO-KMS add-on. Can we confirm blockers?

devin_eng: We support running the keybroker as a sidecar or as a small service in their VPC. Important: need mTLS to customer KMS endpoint and outbound 443 allowed. What's their expected unwrap QPS?

matt_ops: Confirming network: only outbound TLS to their KMS endpoint on 443. Proxy with TLS interception is OK only if it preserves client cert passthrough (we require client cert or mutual TLS). Overhead: proxy + mTLS adds ~25-60ms per unwrap in our tests. If they use a local HSM gateway, expected RTT dominates.

nina_security: For the security questionnaire, we need to capture: HSM vendor & model, attestation reports (FIPS 140-2/3), key custodial model, rotation cadence, and whether keys ever leave their HSM in plaintext. Also ask for SOC2 report if available.

sarah_sales: @nina_security can you draft a minimal Q list I can send to FinLedger? They pushed for a pen-test week — they suggested week of 2026-05-11. Is that feasible?

nina_security: I'll draft. Quick notes to include: 1) we never persist plaintext keys, 2) BYO-KMS means customer signs unwrap requests with their client cert, 3) rotation requires a 2-hour maintenance window for in-place key swap if they want coordinated cutover.

tom_se: Pricing/quote: BYO-KMS add-on is a combination of a flat integration fee + per-request routing fee. For POC we usually waive the integration fee if they commit to a pilot > $20k/month. For estimates I need expected unwraps/minute and retention of audit logs (90 vs 365 days changes cost).

sarah_sales: They said 200 unwraps/sec peak, ~20k/day average, logs for 90d. Can you ballpark a POC quote?

tom_se: Ballpark: pilot discount -> integration fee waived, routing/ops add-on approx $3k/mo + $0.002 per unwrap. With 200rps sustained peak we'd recommend Dedicated routing for predictable latency — that adds a reserved capacity line item. I'll draft numbers and attach.

devin_eng: For the POC: recommend we run our connector in their VPC with peering. To simulate load, we can send a harness (wrk) against a staging HSM endpoint. Example test command to reproduce latency profile:

```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s https://staging-kms.finledger.example.com/unwrap
```
We should also collect TLS handshake traces.

matt_ops: Pen test window week of 2026-05-11 is fine from infra side if they give 72h notice for scope and target IPs. We require a pre-test checklist (no destructive ops, test times, contact on-call). infra-bot: created pen-test-checklist link: https://redwood.internal/pen-test-checklist

sarah_sales: Great. Action items: 1) @nina_security send Q list to FinLedger today, 2) @tom_se draft POC quote with Dedicated routing option + per-unwrap pricing, 3) @devin_eng prepare sidecar runbook + wrk harness, 4) @matt_ops prepare pen-test preflight + provide required IP list. I'll schedule a 30m sync with FinLedger for tomorrow.

infra-bot: Note: have to capture attestation before production cutover. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/byo-kms-runbook

sarah_sales: Thanks all — posting the sync invite now. If anyone has immediate blockers call them out here, otherwise I'll send the questionnaire to the customer in ~30m. :thumbsup:
